description: A third-grade reunion unexpectedly reconnects eight adults whose romantic disasters, marriages and new friendships begin overlapping until the old class becomes a real social circle again.

s01e01.description: Ethan reunites members of his third-grade class for a surprise anniversary party, only for his own relationship to collapse as several old connections restart.

s01e02.description: Ethan and Kat visit Lina after Richie's disastrous accident sends her to hospital, while other classmates confront unfinished business from school.

s01e03.description: Ethan and Kat fight over his ex's leather coat while Lina encourages Richie to stay close and Holly reports from an approaching hurricane.

s01e04.description: Richie and Lina attempt their first proper date while Duncan unexpectedly bonds with Yonk and Holly pressures Kyle over her daughter's school.

s01e05.description: Duncan hires Richie to help renovate Nicole's house, Kat teaches Ethan her frozen-yogurt trick and Lina faces returning to work after the accident.

s01e06.description: Halloween sends Holly to a chaotic petting-zoo broadcast, Duncan and Richie toward Atlantic City, and Ethan and Kat into another argument that resembles flirting.

s01e07.description: Duncan reunites his old band for a bar performance while Nicole, Richie and Lina attend and Ethan and Kat interfere with a blind date.

s01e08.description: A children's birthday party forces Ethan to maintain an awkward deception while Richie and Lina's relationship deepens just as an unexpected visitor arrives.

s01e09.description: Thanksgiving brings the group together as Richie and Lina hit a serious relationship crisis and old history between Duncan and Nicole surfaces at dinner.

s01e10.description: Richie accidentally drives into a convenience store, creating a ridiculous emergency that pulls most of the reunited class together to help him.

s01e11.description: Nicole and Yonk mark their first anniversary, Richie and Lina work through their problems and Kat discovers Ethan is considerably more receptive to her cheerful new neighbor.

s01e12.description: Richie returns home for his belongings and his wife discovers Lina exists, while Ethan recruits Kyle as social protection for Kat at a party.

s01e13.description: Lina admits she and Richie have not yet become intimate, prompting a chain of badly mediated advice among Nicole, Duncan and Richie.

s01e14.description: Ethan and Kyle overhear Kat discussing Benjamin, Nicole grows jealous around Duncan and Lina finally leaves her wheelchair behind.

s01e15.description: Lina and Richie's first dinner party as a couple goes wrong while Nicole struggles with Yonk's diet and Kat receives unsettling news from Benjamin.

s01e16.description: A Valentine's Day snowstorm strands the classmates away from the people they want to see and forces several improvised attempts to reunite.

s01e17.description: Duncan and Richie finish the Allen house repairs, leaving Nicole unexpectedly distressed, while Ethan's attempt to end another relationship acquires an accidental intermediary.

s01e18.description: Duncan and Richie keep Yonk occupied while Nicole prepares to leave, and Ethan discovers a secret that could change Kat's relationship.

s01e19.description: Yonk's heart attack brings the group back to the hospital, where Nicole faces a major decision as Kat, Ethan, Richie and Lina reconsider their futures.
